title: krn doctor --unattended checks App token mint and vault session expiry before unattended work
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c missing item. The bw serve 10h session limit blocked ship overnight (.krn/runs/overnight/status.md 22:38).
Outcome: krn doctor --unattended mints a GitHub App installation token and checks the vault session lifetime against a required window; exits non-zero with the remedy when either fails. The drain command calls it first.
Proof: tests with stubbed mint and vault responses; npm run fast PASS.
